name: High School Internship in Cybersecurity Research
org: ASU Center for Cybersecurity and Trusted Foundations
what_you_do: Do about 8 weeks of cybersecurity research on the ASU Tempe campus. You work 15 to 20 hours a week and meet in person each week.
who_can_apply: Juniors and seniors at a Phoenix-area high school who can attend in person at the Tempe campus. Under 18 needs a parent or guardian sign-off.
duration: About 8 weeks, mostly June and July, 15 to 20 hours per week
deadline_text: Not offered in summer 2026 (paused). Planned to relaunch in summer 2027. No dates or opening posted.
how_to_apply: Application steps are not posted yet. Use the Contact CTF form on the page for updates.
notes: The page says it will be updated when the revamped program opens. Do not plan around it until dates are posted.
